name: Dr. Hardik M Shah
seo_title: Dr. Hardik M Shah — Best Knee Replacement Surgeon in Ahmedabad
seo_description: Dr. Hardik M Shah, Medical Director at DHS Multispecialty Hospital, is a senior knee replacement surgeon in Ahmedabad. VELYS robotic knee replacement, over a decade of joint-replacement experience, FRCS (Germany).
about: Dr Hardik Shah is our esteemed Medical Director and leading orthopedic surgeon at DHS Multispecialty Hospital. With over a decade of experience in the field, Dr. Shah is renowned for his expertise in knee and hip replacements as well as trauma surgeries in Gujarat. He is one of the leading knee replacement surgeons in Ahmedabad.
about_extended: Dr. Hardik Shah graduated with honors from one of India's top medical schools and completed his specialized training in orthopedic surgery at prestigious institutions both in India and abroad. His commitment to advancing medical science and improving patient care has driven him to excel in his field, earning him a reputation as one of the best orthopedic surgeons in Ahmedabad.

specializations.name: VELYS Robotic Knee Replacement
specializations.desc: Dr. Shah leads the robotic joint replacement programme at DHS, performing VELYS robotic-assisted total knee replacement (Johnson & Johnson DePuy Synthes) with the J&J Attune knee implant. The imageless platform delivers sub-millimetre robotic precision and consistent ligament balance, paired with faster recovery and earlier mobilisation.

specializations.name: Knee Replacement Surgery
specializations.desc: Dr. Shah brings over a decade of experience in knee replacement and leads the DHS knee programme, which has successfully performed 2,000+ knee replacement surgeries (robotic and conventional) with high patient satisfaction. His techniques include minimally invasive and robotic-assisted approaches for primary and revision knee replacement.

specializations.name: Hip Replacement Surgery
specializations.desc: With extensive experience in hip replacement surgery — including robotic-assisted hip arthroplasty — Dr. Shah offers patients relief from chronic pain and improved joint function. He is a trusted expert in both partial and total hip replacements.

specializations.name: Trauma Surgery
specializations.desc: As a trauma specialist, Dr. Shah is adept at managing and treating severe musculoskeletal injuries. His quick and effective interventions have saved countless lives and helped patients recover fully from traumatic incidents.

specializations.name: Joint Preservation Surgery
specializations.desc: For patients with early-stage joint issues, Dr. Shah offers joint preservation surgeries, including osteotomies and cartilage restoration procedures, to delay or prevent the need for joint replacement.

closing: Under Dr Hardik Shah's leadership, DHS Multispecialty Hospital continues to thrive as a center of excellence in healthcare and one of the best orthopedic hospitals in Ahmedabad.

name: Dr. Swagat M Shah
seo_title: Dr. Swagat M Shah — Robotic Knee Replacement Surgeon in Ahmedabad
seo_description: Dr. Swagat M Shah is a senior orthopedic and robotic knee replacement surgeon in Ahmedabad at DHS Hospital. VELYS robotic-assisted knee replacement, shoulder replacement, sports medicine. MS Ortho, DNB Ortho, FIAAS UK.
about: Dr. Swagat Shah is a skilled orthopedic surgeon specializing in robotic-assisted joint replacement and sports medicine at DHS Multispecialty Hospital. He performs VELYS robotic knee replacement and shoulder replacement, and his expertise in complex joint procedures has earned him recognition as one of the top orthopedic surgeons in Ahmedabad.

specializations.name: VELYS Robotic Knee Replacement
specializations.desc: Dr. Swagat Shah performs VELYS robotic-assisted knee replacement (Johnson & Johnson DePuy Synthes) at DHS Multispecialty Hospital using the J&J Attune knee implant — an imageless robotic platform that delivers sub-millimetre accuracy with no pre-operative CT scan.

specializations.name: Shoulder Replacement Surgery
specializations.desc: Specialised in primary and revision shoulder replacement, Dr. Shah treats severe arthritis and rotator cuff arthropathy with both anatomical and reverse shoulder arthroplasty.

specializations.name: Sports Medicine & Arthroscopy
specializations.desc: ACL reconstruction, meniscus repair, rotator cuff repair, and return-to-sport rehabilitation for athletes and active patients.

name: Dr. Archit Parikh
about: Dr. Archit Parikh is a consultant physician at DHS Multispecialty Hospital. He has various publications and presentations to his credit and holds a special interest in diabetes management, chronic diseases, and geriatric care.
about_extended: He has expertise in hypertension and infectious disease treatments. He has special focus on treating kidney, liver and lung diseases. He has had immense experience in resolving Dengue, Chikungunya, Malaria, Cholera, Jaundice and other viral infections.
expertise: Diabetes, Thyroid, Cholesterol, Hypertension, Dengue, Chikungunya

name: Dr. Chirag Thakkar
seo_title: Dr. Chirag Thakkar — Laparoscopic & GI Surgeon in Ahmedabad | DHS Hospital
seo_description: Dr. Chirag Thakkar is a GI & laparoscopic surgeon at DHS Hospital, Ahmedabad. Expert in GERD, hernia & obesity surgery. Book a consultation today.
about: Dr Chirag Thakkar is a consultant Gastro-Intestinal, Advanced Laparoscopic and Obesity Surgeon. He is adequately trained and equipped to give the best medical advice and services for patients with gastro-intestinal problems as well as those requiring abdominal, laparoscopic surgeries, weight loss and hernia surgeries.
about_extended: He has special interest in treatment of gastro-esophageal reflux disease (GERD), esophageal motility disorders including achalasia cardia, weight loss and hernia surgery as well as treatment of esophageal and stomach cancers.
